caveat: Categories only. No colour, clarity or turbidity: illumination dominates the pixels and depth is not visible in a photograph. Counts are of what is VISIBLE, which is a lower bound.

records.notable: DUMPED OBJECT: a yellow-and-green drum or barrel, roughly half a metre, half-submerged at the water’s edge. Not a wrapper — a substantial item. Scattered small dark debris on the water around it.
records.notes: Found by the exhaustive sweep. The largest single piece of dumped material anywhere in the archive. Whether it was ever removed is unknown; no later frame covers that spot.
